current_source_binding.scope: Only cleanup ordering, immutable cleanup receipt consumption, post-cleanup sandbox replay, deterministic calibration, projection, and the five observed failing readiness-test entries.
exclusions: No production behavior is changed by this repository map.
P2-08, live calibration, candidate release promotion, source merge, and push remain unauthorized.
Live provider launch must continue to require present mount sources and complete namespace-denial evidence.

current_behavior: ExperimentCommonFinalizer.__call__ seals results/terminal, reloads it with load_experiment_result_bundle, validates it with _validate_sealed_mode_result, and then returns without invoking cleanup_clean_snapshot.
_build_common_result_bundle stores cleanup_status="pending" in the immutable result bundle.
execute_bound_experiment_mode recreates run_dir/repository when it is absent before ExperimentModeController.execute can return _replayed_mode_result.
cleanup_finalization.repair_boundary: Keep cleanup in the common terminal path after seal, reload, and validation. A terminal replay must validate the sealed result and cleanup receipt before deciding whether a snapshot is needed.

disposable_snapshot_cleanup.current_behavior: cleanup_clean_snapshot already bounds the target to run_dir/repository, fsyncs and hashes the sealed result before removal, returns removed, already_absent, or failed, and verifies the result digest again afterwards. Its returned record is not durable authority.
invariants: Delete only the attested run_dir/repository path.
Preserve a terminal result when cleanup fails.
Bind the pre-cleanup and post-cleanup result digests.

current_behavior: The sealed bundle contains immutable cleanup_status and current mode finalization supplies pending.
load_experiment_result_bundle validates the sealed bundle digest and projection identity.
render_experiment_result and render_experiment_comparison do not expose an effective receipt-derived cleanup status.

receipt_contract.publication: Separate create-if-absent immutable JSON outside run_dir/repository after cleanup completes or fails.
required_bindings: bounded failure evidence when status is failed
receipt_contract.immutability_rule: Do not rewrite result.json to report receipt-derived state.

current_behavior: validate_provider_sandbox_descriptor reaches _validate_mount_source, so loading historical sandbox evidence fails once the disposable repository mount source has been deleted.
validate_evaluation_evidence reloads every invocation sandbox through load_provider_sandbox_reference.
historical_contract: Historical mode is permitted only for already sealed, digest-bound terminal lifecycle, sandbox, invocation-set, evaluation, clean-snapshot, and cleanup-receipt evidence.
Historical mode must validate immutable reference digests, canonical payloads, policy digests, namespace-denial evidence, invocation terminal bindings, and receipt/result bindings.
Historical mode may skip only present-day mount-source existence/identity checks for the attested disposable repository that a valid cleanup receipt proves removed or already_absent.
Historical mode must not be available to sandbox publication, launch registration, prelaunch admission, provider launch preparation, evaluator launch preparation, or any live provider path.

preserved_contract: All live and prelaunch callers require canonical existing mount sources.
Repository source identity, runtime/library/credential views, sandbox policy digest, and fresh complete namespace-denial evidence remain mandatory.
No public live API accepts a historical replay flag.

current_behavior: _load_run_record reloads invocation and sandbox authorities with live validators and therefore requires deleted repository mount sources to exist.
_load_run_record calls validate_evaluation_evidence with authority references, which again reloads sandbox descriptors through the live path.
_validate_isolation reports passed only after those live source checks have succeeded.
deterministic_calibration.repair_boundary: Use the sealed-result and valid-cleanup-receipt context to select a historical, digest-bound validation path. Keep the same usage, terminal lifecycle, canary denial, retained leak scan, evaluation, source commit, and projection recomputation checks.

projection_and_rendering.current_behavior: _scan_experiment_results and the database projection carry only the sealed bundle, so cleanup remains pending and cleanup failure is invisible.
repair_boundary: Derive effective cleanup status and receipt reference from authoritative files during scanning.
Make DB and file fallback return the same receipt-derived state.
Treat a missing receipt as incomplete and a failed receipt as failed.
Do not include derived cleanup state in the sealed bundle digest.

five_failure_test_inventory.trigger: _real_calibration_fixture produces terminal runs; after production cleanup, run_deterministic_experiment_calibration reaches _load_run_record and the live sandbox loader rejects the deleted repository mount source.
five_failure_test_inventory.required_recovery_assertion: Deterministic calibration and its idempotent replay pass from sealed digest-bound evidence after run_dir/repository is absent.

five_failure_test_inventory.trigger: The test builds the same cleaned calibration fixture, so mount-source rejection occurs before the intended duplicate-request drift assertion.
five_failure_test_inventory.required_recovery_assertion: Historical replay validation succeeds far enough for forged stable_request_key evidence to fail for the intended duplicate-request reason.

five_failure_test_inventory.trigger: _repository_clone copies the committed tree and overlays tracked diffs; readiness capability validation cannot discover a newly added cleanup schema unless that path is present in the integration Git inventory.
five_failure_test_inventory.required_recovery_assertion: The cleanup receipt schema is tracked and discoverable in the reconstructed repository before readiness relation recomputation.

five_failure_test_inventory.trigger: The action validates fixed capability evidence against a cloned/reconstructed repository and shares the cleanup-schema inventory dependency.
five_failure_test_inventory.required_recovery_assertion: The readiness action can load the tracked cleanup schema while still producing only the exact promoted child commit.

five_failure_test_inventory.trigger: The relation recomputes sealed mode results from _real_calibration_fixture; after cleanup, live sandbox descriptor loading rejects deleted repository sources before the historical relation can be checked.
five_failure_test_inventory.required_recovery_assertion: Gate relation recomputation uses historical digest-bound validation for prior sealed runs, while the provider launcher and all new live executions retain live mount validation.

current_gap_summary: The common finalizer does not call cleanup_clean_snapshot or publish a durable cleanup receipt.
A terminal replay can recreate run_dir/repository before it detects the sealed result.
Sandbox reference loaders conflate live launch validation with digest-bound historical evidence validation.
Deterministic calibration and the P2-09 relation use those live loaders when recomputing sealed historical runs.
Projection and rendering expose the sealed pending value rather than receipt-derived cleanup state.
The cleanup receipt schema must be present in the committed Git inventory before readiness clone/reconstruction tests run.
implementation_order: Define and load the immutable cleanup receipt without changing sealed result authority.
Connect cleanup after common seal, reload, and validation; publish removed, already_absent, or failed evidence and revalidate the sealed result digest.
Make terminal replay validate sealed result plus receipt before any clean-snapshot allocation.
Add an internal historical sandbox/evaluation validation path selected only by a valid sealed-result and cleanup-receipt context.
Keep publication, registration, prelaunch, provider launch, and evaluator launch on strict live validation.
Switch deterministic calibration and historical gate relation recomputation to the historical path.
Project and render receipt-derived effective cleanup state from authoritative files with DB/file parity.
Register the cleanup schema in Git before readiness clone/reconstruction verification.
integration_guards: Seal, reload, and validate results/terminal before cleanup.
A missing receipt is incomplete, not successful.
A failed cleanup receipt remains visible as failed while preserving the terminal result.
Historical replay cannot be selected by live callers.
No live provider call, P2-08 execution, candidate release activation, merge, or push is part of P2-05C-R.
